tool_args.rationale: The pilot varies H only narrowly near the target horizon and ties u_past and mem_conv to other inputs. A trajectory batch can distinguish fast and slow temporal behavior before committing to a numerical model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows are consistent with an approximately linear response to u_now, but their correlated inputs and narrow horizon range do not uniquely identify the transient law.
These authorized mechanisms remain candidates, but the pilot alone does not adequately discriminate their behavior across inputs and time.
It does not target the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
